notes.content:
[New Content]
New character [Gunpowder Maniac] added, obtainable via Advanced Exchange events.
Event [Legendary Opportunity]: Active from 3/20 to 4/3. Daily first Legendary Quest will have increased drop rates for Legendary-tier items.
Event [Mountain Elixir]: Active from 4/3 to 4/17. Complete Old Man Xijin’s Bounties for rewards.
Event [Dangerous Rewards]: Active from 4/17 to 4/24. Daily first Elite Monster kill in Journey Mode will drop doubled loot.
Broker Contracts refreshed, with grand prize replaced by [Raccoon Ronin].
[Character Adjustments]

Chao’er:
Interference skill description corrected:
Original: "Adds a follow-up attack to a random ally" →
Revised: "Adds a follow-up attack to the last-row ally without one (random selection if all have it)".

Cihu:
Roaring Tiger Form (Level 6 stats) adjusted:
Original: "If this buff already exists, grants (Final Damage +10>)" →
Revised: "If this buff already exists, grants (Final Damage +50%>)".
Ambush Tiger Form description fixed:
Original: "Applies debuff (Next time displacement is caused by a skill, takes damage equal to the attack and is stunned)" →
Revised: "Applies two debuffs:
Debuff (Next displacement by a skill inflicts damage equal to the attack).
Debuff (Next displacement by a skill causes stun)."

[Bug Fixes & Optimizations]
Fixed combat reconnection errors caused by Revival mechanics.
Fixed combat freeze when Golden Poison or Mountain Elixir appeared in Retrieval battles.
Fixed combat errors when Wildland Gardener used skills on self-summoned plants.
Fixed Wildland Gardener’s skill [Spirited Plants] not affecting Stun Ferns.
Fixed Cihu’s Roaring Tiger Form Final Damage buff disappearing after one attack (now expires after one attack as intended).
Added UID display at the bottom-right during battles for easier issue reporting.
[New Character Preview: Gunpowder Maniac]

Mecha, a prodigious yet deranged craftsman from the Bian Kingdom.

He scorns traditional weapon forging, obsessing over bizarre inventions while berating peers as mediocre. His crowning achievement—revolutionizing high-efficiency gunpowder—sparked explosive mining tech and primitive firearms, earning him one of Bian’s three "Grand Craftsman" titles.

However, his manic curiosity led him to forbidden research on "Black Miasma" energy, culminating in a catastrophic accident. Stripped of his title and exiled, he now wanders as a paradox: a genius unbound by ethics, conducting perilous experiments in frenzied states—a fusion of madness and brilliance.

notes.title: December 12th-Update
Potential Issues and Solutions After Steam Version Update
notes.content:
Hello everyone,  

We have detected a potential issue that appears to be caused by the Steam platform's update system and network problems.  

Specific symptoms include:  
- Unable to access the game after updating, resulting in a black screen.  

**Solutions:**  
- You can try uninstalling and reinstalling the game.  
- Alternatively, verify the integrity of the game files in the installation folder to repair and update the game package.  

We are actively working to resolve this issue and will update everyone as soon as a fix is available. Thank you for your understanding.

很高兴和大家分享我们最近关于游戏上线时间的一些信息：[b]《安尼姆的无尽旅途》预计将于2024年的第三季度在蒸汽平台与各位玩家见面！！[/b]

在正式上线之前，我们还有一些关于CBT和OBT的计划，将在未来和大家分享。欢迎大家添加愿望单，同时加入我们的官方QQ群：548949208，这样您将不会错过关于游戏的任何新消息。

[url=https://store.steamchina.com/app/2562400/_/]蒸汽平台商店页[/url]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/c4a03e083e1c7ffe886d9d200220ea4826a6c425.png[/img]

此外，我们这次入选了蒸汽平台主办的“东方游戏文化周”活动。可能有一些第一次关注到我们的新朋友，在这里就再做下自我介绍：

《安尼姆的无尽旅途》是一款高难度动物拟人RPG游戏。你将组建一支4人上阵的军团，以第三人称视角，参与这场持续千年的中世纪王座之乱。四方游历中，敌人或来自于权斗，或源自于黑瘴，一切为了生存的抉择都需要你的策略、运气和勇气。

[h2]充满随机的RPG式冒险[/h2]
周游九国土地，危险与奇遇并存。随机的敌人增加了旅途未知的危险，随机事件触发后你是否有勇气接受诱惑与挑战，而一些安尼姆将在路途中与你偶遇，为你带来财富、好运或不幸

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/c3e46a26b48f774252d67c5aaaa1f429b978d921.jpg[/img]

[h2]角色真实死亡[/h2]
如同生命只有一次，安尼姆脆弱的肉体总会在时间中消亡。瘴气的蔓延将会加快生命的流逝，当安尼姆生命将尽，再战还是逃离，超越还是堕落？一线生机就在此刻。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/e8fa457e6387daed6a589bc24e143f30ab113414.jpg[/img]

[h2]高难度精英挑战[/h2]
旅途中你将面对40+不同机制的敌人，20+高难BOSS战。每个敌人都有自己独特的机制，而在洞悉了敌人的弱点后，我们将不再有不可逾越的高山。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/058d8fe7f7461f2f5e5bac57f50903cd06ac5f68.jpg[/img]

[h2]轻文字碎片化叙事[/h2]
在这里，故事剧情将以手绘形式融入游戏的直线体验中。无声的、简洁的、拟喻的，去除繁重文字之后，我们将每只安尼姆的故事，散落在旅途的诸多细微之处。而游戏一开始出现的红狐皇子，仅作为四大主角之一。我们将以POV的叙事形式，一窥这混乱中世纪的绘卷。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/712a1321f4889188212e594baf46a233eee13153.jpg[/img]

[h2]百种独特装备[/h2]
目前一共有120多件装备可在游戏中获得，但它们并不会在你的仓库中成为一个落满灰尘的收藏品。不断地前进，不断地战斗，每一件装备都有自己的特点，每一件装备也都有自己的归宿。大开大合地使用吧，无惧未知的危险！

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/2351e68be246e703714c6a2a2f8343969d5fdce5.jpg[/img]

未来我们还会持续进行内容更新。

作为一款国产游戏，我们在设计之初就本能地以东方视角来建设这个世界。游戏的整体时代风格参考了中国历史上诸侯斗争激烈的战国时期。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/eb31d7ade4000bf8c3702413059fadee3f5a48fa.png[/img]
↑ 仅为我们设计时绘制的概念地图，游戏中为手绘版本

游戏中的角色——华彩将军、歧路之子、彩羽公子等安尼姆，都有着非常鲜明的中式形象设计。
比如下方这只华彩将军，他是一只红腹锦鸡，来自于丘纽——安尼姆世界观中的中式国家，他的服饰参考了明光铠等著名中式铠甲，佩刀则借鉴了唐刀的设计。包括在技能动作和配音上，我们都希望能展现出一个威风凛凛的大将军形象。

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44657512/0674c48428596d39c4ca654c3d0cf70e07f20c9d.png[/img]

中华文化源远流长，我们能在作品中使用并显示其一二，也是非常高兴的事。
感谢由蒸汽平台主办的“东方游戏文化周”能给我们一次展示的平台，期待与诸位见面！
